title: CF Industries Holdings, Inc. Reports First Nine Months 2026 Net Earnings of $1.78 Billion, Adjusted EBITDA of $3.01 Billion
body_markdown:
CF Industries Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: CF), a leading global manufacturer of hydrogen and nitrogen products, today announced results for the nine months and third quarter ended September 30, 2026.


**Highlights**


- First nine months 2026 net earnings (1) of $1.78 billion, or $11.60 per diluted share, EBITDA (2) of $3.00 billion, and adjusted EBITDA (2) of $3.01 billion. First nine months 2026 financial results include a gain of approximately $170 million from a litigation settlement
- Third quarter 2026 net earnings of $436 million, or $2.87 per diluted share, EBITDA of $822 million, and adjusted EBITDA of $833 million
- Trailing twelve months net cash from operating activities of $3.08 billion; free cash flow (3) of $2.03 billion for same period, which includes cash inflows and outflows associated with the Blue Point One joint venture
- Repurchased 3.0 million shares for $367 million during the third quarter of 2026


”The CF Industries team executed exceptionally well in the third quarter of 2026, delivering strong safety performance while operating our network at high rates to meet substantial deferred customer demand,” said Chris Bohn, president and chief executive officer, CF Industries Holdings, Inc. “Our low-cost and low-risk North American asset base, tangible growth platform and industry-leading free cash flow conversion position CF Industries well to continue to create compounding value by investing in high-return initiatives and returning capital to shareholders.”
